title: Vertical rod section
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and translation vector also set to zero. On the first face, draw a 2D sketch consisting of two loops. In the first loop, start by drawing a line from the origin (0.0, 0.0) to (0.0156, 0.0), then continue with a second line from (0.0156, 0.0) to (0.0156, 0.0156), followed by a third line from (0.0156, 0.0156) to (0.0, 0.0156), and finally, a fourth line from (0.0, 0.0156) back to the origin. For the second loop, draw a line from (0.002, 0.002) to (0.0137, 0.002), then from (0.0137, 0.002) to (0.0137, 0.0137), next from (0.0137, 0.0137) to (0.002, 0.0137), and finally, from (0.002, 0.0137) back to (0.002, 0.002). Apply a scale factor of 0.0156 to the entire sketch to adjust its size. Transform the scaled 2D sketch into 3D by rotating it with Euler angles set to zero and translating it with a vector also set to zero. Extrude the transformed sketch 0.75 units along the normal direction to create a solid body. The resulting dimensions of the vertical rod section are 0.015625 units in length, 0.015625 units in width, and 0.7500000000000001 units in height.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the outer rectangle
r = r.box(0.0156, 0.0156, 0.75, centered=(False, False, False))

# Create the inner rectangle
inner_rectangle = cq.Workplane("XY").box(0.0117, 0.0117, 0.75, centered=(False, False, False)).translate((0.002, 0.002, 0))

# Cut the inner rectangle from the outer rectangle
r = r.cut(inner_rectangle)

# The final model is represented as 'r'

import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial sketch
sketch = cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(0, 0).lineTo(0.0156, 0).lineTo(0.0156, 0.0156).lineTo(0, 0.0156).close()

# Define the inner loop
inner_loop = cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(0.0016, 0.0016).lineTo(0.014, 0.0016).lineTo(0.014, 0.014).lineTo(0.0016, 0.014).close()

# Perform the extrusion
extrusion = sketch.extrude(0.75)

# Perform the cut operation
cut = extrusion.cut(inner_loop.extrude(0.75))

# Final model
r = cut
